summary: Frontend-only test of /register-association 2-step flow. 11/16 checks PASS on pure frontend behaviour (all step/validation/back-preservation cases). The 5 FAIL entries are all downstream of ONE backend/env blocker: PostgreSQL is DOWN in this preview container, so GET /api/public/associations/check-code/:code and POST /api/public/associations/register both return HTTP 500 ('Erreur serveur' / 'Can't reach database server at localhost:5432'). PostgreSQL is not even installed (`postgres`, `pg_ctl`, `pg_isready` binaries missing; `dpkg -l | grep -i postgres` empty; nothing listening on :5432). Because of that: (a) 'ASCB' is never reported taken (call errors out → status stays 'idle'), (b) the random TESTxxxxxx code never reaches 'available', and (c) 'Créer mon association' click cannot succeed. The frontend itself is correct: step-1 renders, indicator reads 'Étape 1/2 — Votre compte', ALL 4 local validations block Suivant (empty form, name-only w/o email/phone, password <8, mismatched confirm), Suivant advances to step-2 with indicator 'Étape 2/2 — Votre association', Retour returns to step-1 with name/phone/password fully preserved, and the 'Créer mon association' button correctly disables until codeStatus === 'available'. Google button is disabled (EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID not set) — not counted as failure per the task note.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 'Erreur serveur'. Backend logs show PrismaClientInitializationError: Can't reach database server at localhost:5432. PostgreSQL is not running (and appears not installed) in this preview container.
Cannot be exercised end-to-end because the register-association screen blocks the button until check-code returns 'available', which is impossible while PostgreSQL is down. Same root cause.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be validated end-to-end due to backend DB outage (see backend_issues). Frontend logic gating (codeStatus === 'available' required) is correct; button correctly stays disabled while API is failing.

react_native_issues.issue: Console prints repeated 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Likely a stray whitespace text node between View children (probably around the type <Text style={styles.hint}> inline inside a label, or between JSX blocks). Non-blocking but pollutes logs and can crash on native. Reference: /app/frontend/app/register-association.js
Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely inside GoogleSignInButton or a wrapper. Reference: /app/frontend/components/GoogleSignInButton.js
Warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Present somewhere in shared styles (likely theme or a card style). Non-blocking on web but should be migrated.

action_items: URGENT: Restore PostgreSQL in the preview container. It is missing entirely (no `postgres`/`pg_ctl`/`pg_isready` binaries, nothing on :5432, dpkg shows no postgresql packages) even though backend/.env points at postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/kotiz and Prisma requires it. Without this, ANY public/private endpoint hitting the DB (check-code, register, login, everything) will 500. Install postgresql-15, start it, run `npx prisma migrate deploy` + the existing seed so association ASCB exists again. Then re-run this iteration to confirm the last 3 checks (code taken, code available, final creation with success screen).

Fix the 'Unexpected text node' warnings in /app/frontend/app/register-association.js — search for JSX places where a stray whitespace/text sits directly inside a <View> instead of inside a <Text> (likely near the inline `<Text style={styles.hint}> (min. 8 caractères)</Text>` fragments or between conditional blocks).
Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' to style.pointerEvents in the affected components (see react_native_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: register-association.js correctly implements the 2-step spec: step state, testIDs (register-step-1/2, register-step-indicator, register-next-button, register-back-button, register-create-button, register-admin-*, register-assoc-*), local validation of name/email-or-phone/password>=8/confirm match on Suivant, code availability debounce (500ms), disabled Créer while codeStatus !== 'available', and single final API call (register OR register-google) with combined payload. Back button uses setStep(1) without resetting any state, so admin fields are preserved — verified empirically.
File is 848 lines — borderline; consider splitting the success screen and step-2 form into sub-components for readability (non-blocking).
The Google path capture handler correctly stores idToken in state and only fires POST /register-google when Créer is pressed at step 2 — matches spec (single API call at the end).

Once DB is back and seeded, only 3 checks remain to validate: (1) 'ASCB' shows red XCircle + 'Ce code est déjà utilisé' + create button stays disabled; (2) fresh TESTxxxxxx shows green CheckCircle + 'Code disponible !' + create button enabled; (3) clicking 'Créer mon association' triggers POST /api/public/associations/register and lands on success screen showing the created code. Everything else already passes.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: PostgreSQL server is absent from the preview container (packages not installed, no listener on 5432). Prisma throws PrismaClientInitializationError on every DB query; the check-code and register endpoints catch it and return HTTP 500 'Erreur serveur'. The register-association frontend is correct: it debounces the check-code call, keeps codeStatus 'idle' when the request errors, keeps the 'Créer mon association' button disabled, and never triggers the final POST — exactly the safe behaviour. Reproduction: `curl https://ascb-join-request.preview.emergentagent.com/api/public/associations/check-code/ASCB` → 500. Mitigation: install and start postgresql-15, restore the Prisma schema (`npx prisma migrate deploy`), and re-seed the ASCB association; then re-run this iteration's playwright script to green-light the remaining 5 checks.
